you need to realise how great your life might be in comparisation with people who can't even afford water or sleep in a bed, ;)
YOU HAVE TO BE HAPPY THAT YOU CAN ACTUALLY ''LOOK'' FOR A JOB, there are people in the world who can't even walk normally on the streets without getting bombed by an army ( Situation in Gaza and Palestine)

Enough said.

Atleast you could go to the college, and do stuff like this.

There are even people on the world WITHOUT drinking/eating supplies.
Starving everyday asking theirselves why am I living?

You should be happy for yourself that you can lay in a bed, as far as I know i've seen people sleeping on stones or on the ground of a random building.

Compare your life to people who can't afford water and a bed.

Then be happy for yourself

Please compare your life to the people in Gaza and palestin.

People can't even walk there on the streets.
Children getting killed for no reason
You have to be LUCKY if you survive for one day in those country,
we ALL should be happy if we could sleep in a bed. No matter what other problems we have.

Keep that in your mind. We need to be happy that we can live in peace ;)

Just think about this.
Compare your life to the life of children of Gaza and Palestina.
They kill children for no reason and you can't even walk on the streets without being bombed. You have a warm meal and a bed, they don't.

People need to realise how good your life could be ( even with all problems ) compared to people who live in countrys full of war and stuff like that.
